content: Protobuf for WA wire: Google.Protobuf 3.36.2 stable BSD-3-Clause (4.0.0-rc2 exists, do not adopt yet) with Grpc.Tools 2.84.0 for protoc codegen at build time (PrivateAssets=all). protobuf-net 3.4.30 Apache-2.0 rejected: diverges from official protoc semantics on proto2 edge cases; official protoc matches whatsmeow (google.golang.org/protobuf 1.36.12) and Baileys (protobuf.js) enabling byte-level cross-checks. Source NuGet v3 flatcontainer/registration. Confidence HIGH.
